nonReversible.LOTO_CASH_PRIZE: Loto cash prizes are reversed only as part of their session basket — void or refund the basket from one of its other rows on this page, or from the Loto page.
nonReversible.LOTO_SETTLEMENT: A settled Loto checkpoint can't be refunded or voided here — correct it with a new checkpoint/settlement from the Loto page.
nonReversible.REFUND: This row is itself a refund — it can't be refunded or voided again. An admin can undo a per-item refund right from this row ("Undo refund"); other refunds have no undo yet.
nonReversible.REFUND_UNDO: This row already undoes a refund — it can't be refunded, voided, or undone again.
nonReversible.CREDIT_CASH_OUT: Correct this from the Debts page with an opposite manual entry — voiding here would return the cash without restoring the client's credit.
nonReversible.CREDIT_CASH_IN: Correct this from the Debts page with the opposite manual entry (Add Debt cancels Add Credit) — that corrects both the drawer and the client's balance.
nonReversible.DEBT_CASH_OUT: Correct this from the Debts page with the opposite manual entry (Add Credit cancels Add Debt) — that corrects both the drawer and the client's balance.
nonReversible.KEPT_CHANGE: Nothing to reverse on this row by itself — the kept change stays in the drawer either way. Void or refund the sale this change belongs to instead.
nonReversible.EXTRA_CHARGE: Nothing to reverse on this row by itself — it only records the extra charged at checkout. Void or refund the customer's basket instead; that removes it too.
nonReversible.WAIVED_SHORTFALL: Nothing to reverse on this row by itself — it only records the amount waived at checkout. Void or refund the customer's basket instead; that removes it too.
nonReversible.WARRANTY_COST: This is the cost of a warranty claim. To undo it, void the claim from the Warranty page — that reverses everything the claim did.
nonReversible.PARTNER_ADJUSTMENT: Correct this from the Partners page with an opposite Add Credit/Debt entry.
nonReversible.ACCOUNT_ADJUSTMENT: Correct this from the Accounts page with an opposite Add Credit/Debt entry.
nonReversible.SUPPLIER_ADJUSTMENT: Correct this from the Suppliers page with an opposite Add Credit/Debt entry.
nonReversible.COUNTERPARTY_DISCOUNT: Correct this with an opposite discount from the Partners/Suppliers page, not a refund here.
nonReversible.MTC_TOPUP: Correct this with an opposite manual top-up from the Recharge page.
nonReversible.ALFA_TOPUP: Correct this with an opposite manual top-up from the Recharge page.
nonReversible.DRAWER_TOPUP: Correct this with an opposite transfer from the Dashboard.
nonReversible.DRAWER_CASHOUT: Correct this with an opposite Drawer Top-Up from the Dashboard.
nonReversible.HOLD_MONEY: Held money is reversed from the Hold Money page (collect or adjust it there), not with a refund here.
nonReversible.HOLD_MONEY_COLLECT: Undo a pickup from the Hold Money page ("Void pickup"), not with a refund here.
nonReversible.HOLD_MONEY_COLLECT_VOID: This row already reverses a Hold Money pickup — it can't be reversed again.
nonReversible.LOTO_MONTHLY_FEE: Correct this from the Loto monthly-fee page, not with a refund here.
nonReversible.CHECKPOINT: Checkpoints are a point-in-time count, not a transaction to undo — correct a bad count with a new checkpoint.
nonReversible.CARRIER_LINE_ADJUSTMENT: Correct this by editing the carrier line again from the MTC/Alfa page — a hand-edit is a standing correction, not something to reverse.
nonReversible.CLIENT_CREATED: This is a client-record audit entry, not a money transaction — there's nothing to refund.
nonReversible.CLIENT_UPDATED: This is a client-record audit entry, not a money transaction — there's nothing to refund.
nonReversible.CLIENT_DELETED: This is a client-record audit entry, not a money transaction — there's nothing to refund.

confirm.void: Void this transaction? This cannot be undone.
confirm.undoRefund: Undo this refund? It restores the stock, drawer, customer debt, and profit it changed — this cannot be undone again.
confirm.refund: Refund this transaction? A reversal entry will be created.
confirm.refundExchange: Refund this exchange? The money is swapped back: the shop returns what it received and the customer returns what they were given.
confirm.voidCheckoutUnits: Void the entire {{count}}-unit checkout? Every unit's money, cost, and profit will be reversed. This cannot be undone.
confirm.voidCheckoutMulti: Void the entire multi-unit checkout? Every unit's money, cost, and profit will be reversed. This cannot be undone.
confirm.voidBasket: Void the entire session #{{id}} basket? Every item's money, cost, and profit will be reversed, including any loto prize or account credit from this basket. This cannot be undone.
confirm.refundBasket: Refund the entire session #{{id}} basket? Every item's money, cost, and profit will be reversed, including any loto prize or account credit from this basket. This cannot be undone.
